title: Complex organic molecules in low-mass protostars on Solar System scales. I. Oxygen-bearing species
question: What are the abundance ratios of O-bearing COMs relative to CH3OH on ~100 AU scales in Class 0 protostars, and how do they compare to other low-mass protostars, cold vs hot components, and methanol D/H?

evidence.quote: (1) Ortiz-León et al. (2018). (2) Enoch et al. (2009).

external_data.citation: Ortiz-León et al. 2017, 2018; Enoch et al. 2009, 2011; Karska et al. 2018; Hirano & Liu 2014

evidence.quote: 12 C/ 13 C = 70 and 16 O/ 18 O = 560, respectively.

what.value: Comparison abundances for IRAS 16293B, HH 212, IRAS 2A/4A, IRAS 16293A

evidence.quote: The HH 212 abundances are from Lee et al. (2019a).

external_data.citation: Jørgensen et al. 2018; Lee et al. 2019a; Taquet et al. 2015, 2019; Manigand et al. 2020

evidence.quote: The line lists of each molecule were taken from the CDMS

external_data.citation: CDMS (Müller et al. 2001, 2005; Endres et al. 2016); JPL (Pickett et al. 1998)

recipe.method: Continuum from line-free channels, continuum subtraction, tclean line images with masks; spectra extracted from central beam

recipe.goal: Fit LTE models to get column densities and Tex
recipe.method: Grid of N, Tex, FWHM per species; minimum reduced chi2; Band 3 and 6 modeled separately; optically thick and blended lines excluded
key_parameters: N grid 1e13-1e17 cm-2 (step 0.05 dex), Tex 50-550 K (10 K), FWHM 0.5-9.0 km/s (0.1)
Tex fixed to 200 K for species with few lines; Band 3 Tex set to Band 6; B1-bS FWHM fixed to 1 km/s
assumptions: Source size 0.45" for all sources; single Tex; Gaussian line profiles; column densities are lower limits

recipe.goal: Derive CH3OH column density and abundance ratios
recipe.method: CH3OH scaled from 13CH3OH (Band 3) and CH3 18OH (Band 6); abundances relative to CH3OH
assumptions: CH3OH used as reference because CO traces more extended regions

recipe.goal: Fit cold extended component in Band 3
recipe.method: Two-component model: Band 6 best fit kept fixed as warm/hot; cold component Tex=60 K, N fitted, source size 2.0"
CH2DOH/CH3OH corrected by statistical weight factor 3, compared to GRAINOBLE model

evidence.quote: In Band 3, this gives a D/H ratio of 1.9±0.7%, < 4.3%, and < 3.3% for B1-c, S68N, and B1-bS respectively.
These deuteration fractions correspond to a temperature during the formation of methanol of ∼ 15 K
the average excitation temperature in Band 3 is ∼ 30 K lower than in Band 6.
The average FWHM for B1-c and S68N in Band 6 is 3.3±0.2 and 5.0±0.2 km s −1, respectively

evidence.loc: 4.1 Occurrence of COMs in young protostars
evidence.quote: implies an R T =100K of 37.4 AU, 35.8 AU, and 11.6 AU for B1-c, S68N, and B1-bS, respectively.
